summary: Implemented the print_json feature (not run, not committed). Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", one combined pattern: brace, literals, number with hex first, str). rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or NullHighlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns the Text) plus the __main__ CLI with stderr error and exit -1. rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print with a lazy import. rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print, delegating to the global console. rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* keys. Tests: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py (exact truecolor escapes derived by hand) and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py. Docs: "Printing JSON" section in console.rst, new reference/json.rst with toctree entry, and a changelog line under Unreleased Added. Open point: overflow=None follows the spec literally, but lines wider than the terminal may still be cropped; "ignore" would prevent that. Tests were not run, so the hand-derived ANSI expectations are unverified.
